provenance.sourceAccessMethod: Complete assigned index.html, sources.md and independent-check.md read locally after README and VOICE-GUIDE. Batch31 Markdown/data inspected for format only. No other source run, network research, build or publication during batch32 authoring.
provenance.originalResearchAccessLimitations: Strict clean-session-only compliance NOT MET in original research: public fetch/search tools automatically touched existing managed-browser routes. Later anonymous official captures do not retroactively cure this. Rate output from Bank of Taiwan fallback was excluded; planning FX remains an assumption. No new source refresh or access-date claim.
provenance.independentCheckDisposition: Assigned independent check found no numerical corrections. H5/H6 exact NHI tariff tables could not be independently reopened (403; absent raw captures), and full C2 nonprofit PDF could not independently be re-established due truncation. Conditional amounts/eligibility remain source-author evidence, not newly independently certified. Nursing 2027 dates are indexed primary plans, not final timetables.
provenance.layoutEvidenceLimit: No batch32 build, rendered HTML, browser or print certification. Original director layout observations do not certify the new Markdown.

datePolicy: Every cited source access date retained as 2026-11-07. Document/listing dates are separate; no 2027 rule, quote or vacancy is assumed. Copy editing is not a refresh.

planningAssumptions.profile: Hong Kong UX designer, HK RN spouse and daughter aged two on 2026-11-07; mid-2027 Taiwan move. Actual passports/status, birthday and eligibility unverified.
routeOrder: Wife HF160 / family HF161 professional residence assessed in parallel
Genuine Taiwan-sponsored professional employment HF171/HF172 fallback

monthly_rows.item: Groceries, household food + modest eating out
Public transport / occasional taxis; no car
Childcare — gross private fallback, no subsidy
Insurance / NHI envelope — actual quote needed
HK payroll / pension buffer — verify arrangement
Taiwan / HK tax reserve — not a liability ceiling

planningAssumptions.assumptionStatus: Living costs, gap insurance, payroll/pension and tax reserve are unconfirmed planning allocations, not quotations, assessed liability or proof of adequate cover. Savings do not establish investment residence.
planningAssumptions.exclusions: No business capital/operating losses, adult tuition, car, helper or international school. Refundable security is tied-up cash. First month rent is not counted twice as spending.

uncertainties: Each passport, nationality, permanent status, mainland birthplace/history, marriage/parentage and chosen legal lane.
Actual Digital duties/employer industry, gross pay, annual tax/salary evidence and accepted buying-cash conversion; no qualification approval.
Wife HF160 detailed medical-professional conditions and personal qualification; dependent husband remote-work rights not established.
Exact HK-status dependent spouse individual work-permit applicability is unconfirmed; generic foreign-spouse rule cannot silently be applied.
No actual Taiwan sponsor/job/category/qualifying employee evidence. Investment/innovation operation and capital unapproved; student/graduate reforms not fully reconciled for a later case.
Remote HK-job NHIA classification/enrollment unit and family waiver; each residence/employment/travel clock, final 2027 brackets.
No insurance underwriting, accepted relocation policy, actual quote or proven adequacy of insurance/self-pay reserves.

Nursing initial school/award, graduation date, theory and actual clinical hours; bridging place, 2027 review procedures, final nursing timetable and HK-language arrangements unconfirmed. No licensing date or nursing wage.

Child birthday/nationality, HK-permit equivalence, parent/child address/documents, subsidized copayment, private acceptance, July vacancy, final 116 age bands/dates/fees and late-entry bill unconfirmed. Cash allowance not deducted.
Listings dated, Zhongshan already let, Banqiao no-partitions conflict; true enclosed bedrooms, area basis, physical safety/layout, terms and 2027 availability unverified.
FX 4.00 and 3.60 are assumptions, not rates. Thin monthly margin can turn negative. MPF buffer is not a mandatory-contribution finding.

2026 full-year resident tax illustration not 2027/move-year assessment; 2025-return child deduction source; HK relief/provisional taxes can exceed reserve. Not immigration, nursing-registration or tax advice.
Historic clean-session deviation, H5/H6 independent-table and C2 PDF completeness gaps remain unresolved; no new research or certification.
editingContract: Batch32 new en/zh Markdown, shared schema-v2 JSON and short taipei author note only. No shared inventory/build/check code, source-run edits, build, network, contact or publication. Marker-only footer delegated to builder.

audience.en: Hong Kong family planning a mid-2027 move to Taiwan on one HK remote UX salary, with an HK registered-nurse spouse and toddler, comparing residence, healthcare, childcare and housing cash flow.
audience.zh: 计划在 2027 年中举家从香港搬到台湾的香港家庭：靠一份香港远程 UX 薪资，配偶是香港注册护士，孩子还是幼儿，要比较居留、医疗、托育和住房的现金流。
audience.zh-Hant: 計畫在 2027 年中舉家從香港搬到台灣的香港家庭：靠一份香港遠端 UX 薪資，配偶是香港註冊護理師，孩子還是幼兒，要比較居留、醫療、托育與住房的現金流。

localeReason: English, Simplified Chinese and Traditional Chinese all serve this Hong Kong-family relocation decision. Traditional Chinese (zh-Hant, pilot) matches the written form most Hong Kong and Taiwan readers and Taiwan documents use; it changes no identity, status or eligibility.
